why: WO-1.17: HOW to ask query1.finance.yahoo.com's v8 chart endpoint for 26 years of DAILY bars, given that ingestion.backfill_calendar.yahoo_observation_dates needs the whole date list and the live loop's range=10d/2y reaches nowhere near a backfill episode in 2000. The specific thing measured here is whether range=max — honoured, listed in every symbol's validRanges, and the first thing a caller reaches for — serves interval=1d or SILENTLY COARSENS it, because a coarsened 200 would be read as a daily publication calendar and would tell the backfill to recover dates the symbol never printed on while never mentioning the ones it did
